supporting_observations.claim: At 13:49:22 UTC, WS-MSANTOS-01 initiated an HTTP connection to 10.54.20.30:8080 with 51,000,317 bytes sent by the origin and 8,896 bytes received. The inventory identifies this endpoint as the explicit web proxy.

The available connection record does not identify the requested URL or external destination, the process responsible, or the transferred content, so it does not establish whether the large transfer was an authorized upload or exfiltration.
The observed large connection is timestamped 13:49:22 UTC, rather than precisely at the alert's stated approximate time of 13:46 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided network record contains connection-level byte counts but no proxy request or destination details, URL, user-agent, or content.
The provided records do not attribute the proxy connection to a process or identify files involved.
The records do not show whether the proxy forwarded the data to an external service or what the ultimate recipient was.
claims_not_established: That the transfer was malicious or involved data exfiltration.
That the transfer was an authorized Microsoft 365/OneDrive upload or another legitimate activity.
What data, if any, was transferred, or who received it.
Which process or user action generated the large proxy connection.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve PROXY-BLU-01 access logs for the connection at 13:49:22 UTC, including requested host/URL, CONNECT target, authenticated user, user-agent, and upstream byte counts.
Collect endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-MSANTOS-01 around 13:49 UTC.
Check Microsoft 365/OneDrive audit and client activity, and relevant file-access or DLP records, for a matching upload.
Determine the ultimate destination and assess whether the transferred data and recipient were authorized.
unrelated_findings: PanGPS.exe ran as SYSTEM on WS-MSANTOS-01; the inventory states there is no VPN and remote administration is limited to WS-KITO-01. The supplied records do not show that PanGPS established a connection or that it was involved in the alerted transfer. Investigate separately. (T199-00028, T199-00029)
